items.html: And this is the word "her food" (She'era), from the language of remnants (Shiurin). For in Atzilut everything is corrected in the secret of a complete Partzuf; in Beria there is a slight lack; in Yetzira there is a greater lack; but in Assiya there is no correction at all — only what was left over for it, which is the first aspect of the three within three (Gimmel be-Gimmel), of the secret of the Ibur. For the coupling that is useful for this aspect is only for the need of vitality for themselves, like the vitality given to the fetus while it is in its mother's womb.
